name: Samantha Radocchia

subhead.web: Anthropologist and technologist who builds. Four companies, four granted patents, two books, and field research from the Sacred Valley to a QAnon Discord server, all pointed at one problem: perceptual security, or what a society does when it can no longer agree on what is real. I build the systems, then go and see what happens to them.
subhead.professional: Anthropologist and technologist. Four-time founder, first-named inventor on four granted US patents, and a field researcher in illicit economies. I build the systems, then go and see what happens to them.
subhead.academic: Anthropologist working on perceptual security and illicit economies. Field research in Peru, Mexico, Ecuador, Colombia, Israel, and inside two persistent virtual worlds. Named inventor on four granted US patents in identity and provenance.

interests: Perceptual security: how synthetic media and cognitive manipulation alter what individuals and institutions are able to treat as real. Convergence in illicit economies, where trafficking, laundering, and contraband share corridors and infrastructure. Provenance and authentication of physical and digital objects. Identity formation in simulated and virtual landscapes. National myth and collective consciousness.
glance: Co-founder, Illicit Shadows and MISTIC. Founder, RADOC. Keynote speaker.

fieldwork.label: 2024 – present
fieldwork.html:
Mindo, Ecuador
State actors and infrastructure in illicit economies: how public institutions and physical logistics are co-opted or captured.

Medellín, Colombia
Use of marketplace dating applications by transnational organized crime groups for recruitment and targeting. Platform ethnography and offline follow-through.

Pisac, Peru and the Yucatán, Mexico
Convergence in illicit trade: where human trafficking and forced labor, money laundering, and contraband movement meet in the same corridors and the same local economies.

SamRad.AI · autoethnography
Built a working cognitive, vocal, and visual likeness of herself, trained on fifteen years of her own commonplace books, published writing, and public output, then studied what it was able to do: hold opinions on material it had never seen, and convince colleagues and family on a video call. The most capable version was withheld from release. The project produced the questions that became her work on perceptual security.

Discord · virtual
Cognitive and narrative attack vectors through perceptual communities of practice. Case study on Pastel QAnon.

Israel
Independent research on the role of national myth in establishing collective consciousness and identity.

Second Life · virtual
Constructing Identity in Virtual and Simulated Landscapes: an ethnography of Second Life. Among the first anthropologists to conduct sustained participant observation inside a persistent virtual world.

appointments.html:
CEO & Co-Founder, NYOUM Ltd · London
Founded and led an applied AI company from zero to product. Built YOUM.AI, an AI-native video communication platform, and the research function behind it: natural language processing, large language models, machine translation, speech and facial recognition, and biometrics. Hired the team, set the research agenda, took the product to market in the US, then led the pivot and the handover to a regional CEO.Built: an AI research function from scratch · one platform to market · the pivot decision and succession

Co-Founder, Chronicled · San Francisco
Chief Product Officer, 2014 to 2018 · Chief Marketing Officer, 2018 to 2019
Venture-backed enterprise software company, $30M+ raised, 50+ staff. Founded the company's innovation infrastructure: the Blockchain × IoT Laboratory, the Enterprise Protocol Lab, and Blockchain for Better. Evaluated 1,500+ use cases across consumer and enterprise markets, incubated 20+ industry ecosystems, and brought 10+ products to market across authentication, cold chain, secure sealing, and track and trace. Built the MediLedger network (Pfizer, Genentech, AmerisourceBergen, McKesson, Cardinal Health) and Responsible Gold. Founding member of the Enterprise Ethereum Alliance, Trusted IoT Alliance, and MOBI. Educated 250+ Fortune 500 C-suite executives and board members. Hired the initial team of 50+ designers and engineers, and acquired an additive manufacturing company to bring hardware in house.Illicit markets addressed: counterfeit pharmaceuticals and diverted product, counterfeit luxury goods and apparel, illicit precious metals and minerals, gray-market automotive parts, and food fraud.

Founder & CEO, Stunable · New York
Built machine-learning recommendation systems for e-commerce, including the first-of-its-kind "fashion genome project" mapping consumer taste. Pioneered single-click inventory integration; the synchronization engine was used by 10,000+ merchants. Raised the funding, ran the company, and negotiated a multi-year docuseries contract with NBC as part of go-to-market. Markets: fashion and direct-to-consumer.Built: a taste-mapping ML system · an inventory engine at 10,000+ merchant scale · a network television partnership

Faculty, Singularity University · Santa Clara, CA
Speaking and executive leadership training, held alongside her founder roles and degrees. Designed and delivered executive innovation programs on technological, socio-cultural, and geopolitical convergence. Built workshops and prototyping formats used at global summits, and ran foresight sessions for Fortune 100 leadership teams on distributed ledgers, machine learning, advanced manufacturing, and extended realities.Built: executive program curriculum · prototyping and foresight workshop formats · keynote practice to audiences of 3,000+

appointments.html:
Founder, Radical Next · personal consulting and R&D practice
Started in college and run alongside every role since. An innovation vehicle for work with Fortune 500 companies, startups, non-profits, and governments. Projects: decentralized manufacturing and IP storage with 3D printers for a Fortune 100 industrial manufacturer; values and ingredient-based recommendation with decentralized shopper data for a global consumer goods company; identity and currency deployment in a Venezuelan and Brazilian refugee camp; secure file storage for journalists and sources in conflict zones; tracking of volatile substances and chemicals for a Fortune 50 energy company and a global oil major; autonomous vehicle delivery and authentication; large-scale virtual world architecture and asset protocol for a blockchain gaming platform.
